description.value: The Travelodge by Wyndham Hope is a branded chain hotel situated on Old Hope-Princeton Way in Hope, BC, a gateway town at the confluence of the Fraser and Coquihalla rivers and a natural rest stop on several major touring routes. As part of the Wyndham portfolio it offers standard hotel amenities in a convenient highway location. Touring cyclists passing through on the Kettle Valley Railway route or the Trans Canada corridor would find it a straightforward overnight option in an otherwise limited accommodation landscape.

The OSM record confirms the hotel exists at 350 Old Hope-Princeton Way, Hope, BC, and the page title 'Travelodge by Wyndham Hope | Hope, BC Hotels' corroborates the property identity and that it is open. Wi-Fi is tagged in OSM (internet_access=wlan) but cannot be confirmed from website content per the rules, so it is left null; all cyclist-specific criteria are null due to absence of evidence.
